full_judgment:
2. The plaintiff claims that he purchased 12 decimals of land from defendant Nos. 1 and 2 from RS Plot Nos. 2702 and 2701 and possession of 8 decimals from Plot No. 2702 and 4 decimals from Plot No. 2701 was delivered to him and since his purchase, he has been in possession of his purchased land. The plaintiff further claims that the part of Plot No. 2701 of which possession was given to him is khas land and the Government has already served notice to vacate that land. The plaintiff also claims that by suppressing the real fact, the defendants sold land of khas khatian to him. After filing the partition suit, the plaintiff made a prayer for issuing temporary injunction against the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 restraining them from making any construction in the suit property the total of area of which is 23 decimals plus 4 decimals excess land recorded in khas khatian. The prayer for temporary injunction was allowed by the court of the Subordinate Judge. Then the defendants filed a miscellaneous appeal before the High Court Division against that order which was allowed. Being aggrieved by the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division in FMA No. 145 of 2002, the plaintiff now seeks leave to appeal against that judgment and order. 

 3. Mr. Khandker Mahbubuddin Ahmed, the learned Counsel who appeared on behalf of the petitioner, has submitted that the land sold to the plaintiff includes some land of khas khatian and if that land is ultimately kept out of partition and if construction is made by the defendants in some portion of the partible land, the plaintiff will be deprived of getting his due share of land. He has admitted that the principle has now been settled that in case of land in urban areas there shall not be any injunction restraining construction by a co-sharer but he has argued that in the instant case, the plaintiff will be deprived of his due share and for that reason injunction should be issued against the respondents from making any construction till disposal of the Partition Suit.
